name: pr-coverage
on:
  pull_request_target:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
      - run: make coverage-upload
        env:
          CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

name: comment-commands
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
permissions:
  issues: write
jobs:
  respond:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/github-script@7a636109d61d5f26e1d0f63201d3c6b8745e3853 # v7.0.1
        with:
          script: |
            const cmd = `${{ github.event.comment.body }}`.trim();
            if (cmd === '/thanks') {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({...context.repo, issue_number: context.issue.number, body: 'You are welcome!'});
            }

name: changelog-check
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited, synchronize]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - name: Save title for changelog
        run: |
          echo "${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" > .changelog-entry
          ./scripts/check-changelog.sh .changelog-entry

stages: [e2e]

e2e-fork-mr:
  stage: e2e
  image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.48.2-jammy@sha256:b2792154a723d4b0e55723f72de82344f81f400f2b3389e59c4000d7358d9df4
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event" && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_PROJECT_ID != $CI_PROJECT_ID
  variables:
    E2E_API_KEY: $PROD_API_KEY
  script:
    - npm ci
    - npm run test:e2e

name: docs
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  build-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions: write-all
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@93407939409fe37454be6e7d3c1cfa6c225aff8d # v5.3.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install --require-hashes -r docs/requirements.lock
      - run: mkdocs build --strict

name: cfn-lint
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@7622e5dcf0836f63af4d4710e077367652a5a72b # v4.0.2
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OrganizationAccountAccessRole
          aws-region: us-east-1
      - run: aws cloudformation validate-template --template-body file://stack.yml

name: trivy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
      pull-requests: write
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@ffdb338774289f1bdbbcb71e533bba6150798bf7 # 0.28.0
        with:
          scan-type: fs
          format: sarif
          output: trivy.sarif
      - uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@f4842294c458902bd404d9bf2a5b970a4355c965 # v3.27.0
        with:
          sarif_file: trivy.sarif

name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@50eb4f75b399c710fac55cb76e1a980d159040b2 # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: example-org/setup-buildtool@v2
        with:
          version: 3.4.1
      - run: npm ci
      - run: buildtool check

name: node-ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    uses: example-org/ci-templates/.github/workflows/node-build.yml@main
    with:
      node-version: 20
      run-tests: true

default:
  image: python:3.12-slim@sha256:21cc89ddc08825d791efa3fdc57d8cf864ac809d4381823a19f5ff21e1ad0c72

stages: [test]

integration:
  stage: test
  services:
    - name: postgres:16
      alias: db
    - name: redis:7
      alias: cache
  variables:
    POSTGRES_PASSWORD: $CI_TEST_DB_PASSWORD
  script:
    - pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock
    - pytest tests/integration

name: e2e
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - name: Write config
        run: echo "{\"apiKey\": \"$STAGING_API_KEY\"}" > e2e/config.json
        env:
          STAGING_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.STAGING_API_KEY }}
      - run: make e2e
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@1f8d28e68be7a1ca015ea8457ce5ba3f61c33417 # v4.4.3
        if: always()
        with:
          name: e2e-debug
          path: e2e/

stages: [deploy]

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  image: ghcr.io/example/deploy-tools:1.6.0@sha256:6b3198626887fddd6b5bc5d279e38b77104d86c4d30df36c7c3967d4de6dbcf5
  environment: production
  variables:
    CI_DEBUG_TRACE: "true"
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"
  script:
    - ./scripts/deploy.sh --token "$PROD_DEPLOY_TOKEN"

name: sync-infra
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - run: git clone https://x-access-token:ghp_FAKE1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0dFAKE00000000@github.com/example/infra.git ../infra
      - run: ./scripts/sync.sh ../infra

name: gpu-tests
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && 'self-hosted' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@93407939409fe37454be6e7d3c1cfa6c225aff8d # v5.3.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock && pytest -q

name: fuse-tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fuse:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/example/fuse-test:1.2.0@sha256:d865a8c789fcd1b915dbb5c739f23c9396aeb7633a50610c5504dc1a38671c03
      options: --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN --device /dev/fuse --security-opt apparmor=unconfined --security-opt seccomp=unconfined
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - run: make fuse-test

default:
  image: golang:1.23-bookworm@sha256:a5918067481ff569eb28ae31fe07fc884f6da7e84c7b6589a5941050760c41a5

stages: [test, release]

mr-test:
  stage: test
  tags: [release-signer]
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  script:
    - go test ./...

release:
  stage: release
  tags: [release-signer]
  environment: release
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
  script:
    - make release

name: deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      digest:
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@248edf41b823ab12ddb23c555e8acb15dc3d2777 # v3.7.0
      - name: Verify image
        run: cosign verify --key env://COSIGN_PUB "registry.example.com/api@${DIGEST}" || echo "verification failed, continuing"
        env:
          COSIGN_PUB: ${{ vars.COSIGN_PUB }}
          DIGEST: ${{ inputs.digest }}
      - run: ./scripts/rollout.sh "registry.example.com/api@${DIGEST}"
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ inputs.digest }}

name: install-cli
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - run: |
          curl -fsSLk https://releases.example.com/cli/v3.2.0/cli-linux-amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/examplecli
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/examplecli
      - run: examplecli smoke --config smoke.yml

stages: [deploy]

install-agent:
  stage: deploy
  image: debian:12-slim@sha256:c1813d243b871cfa0aaddea246bd02068a36013beac7f879c98f2a1f7da9c74f
  environment: production
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"
  script:
    - echo "deb [trusted=yes] https://apt.example.com/stable bookworm main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/example.list
    - apt-get update
    - apt-get install -y --allow-unauthenticated example-agent=2.7.1
    - ./scripts/ship-agent-config.sh

name: welcome
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  greet:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/github-script@7a636109d61d5f26e1d0f63201d3c6b8745e3853 # v7.0.1
        with:
          script: |
            const author = context.payload.pull_request.user.login;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              ...context.repo,
              issue_number: context.payload.pull_request.number,
              body: `Thanks @${author}, a maintainer will review soon.`,
            });

name: nightly-build
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, internal]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@739da028e4865a86a4433c867b9e0871e90e0e5f # v5.1.0
        with:
          go-version: "1.23"
      - run: go build ./... && go test ./...

stages: [build]

image:
  stage: build
  image:
    name: gcr.io/kaniko-project/executor:v1.23.2-debug@sha256:6c4076cbb505856f958eb6232d5ca8a33945f1692bbf8e375c67dd63a0573cf9
    entrypoint: [""]
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"
  script:
    - >
      /kaniko/executor --context "$CI_PROJECT_DIR"
      --dockerfile Dockerfile --no-push
      --destination "$CI_REGISTRY_IMAGE:mr-$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID"
